scope: DR1/DR4/DR5/DR6 methodological review; no new incident claims or Telegram collection
retrieval_method: web browsing of public primary documentation, reports and original study abstracts/full texts as specified per item
raw_preservation: Created as a new receipt; no existing raw files edited. Metadata and claim notes, not a full-content archive.

sources.title: Timing matters when correcting fake news

sources.verification: browsed primary indexed abstract; full PMC open challenged; NSF-hosted author PDF search result verifies online date
sources.supports: Two experiments N=2683; after-headline correction improved later discernment. Does not test hours-long crisis response delay. DOI 10.1073/pnas.2020043118; journal issue 2021-02-02.
sources.independence_note: One source item; abstracts, reports, reposts and author versions of the same underlying study are not independent evidence.

sources.title: CERC: Crisis and Emergency Risk Communication — Introduction
